title: @include order(2) on .extra-info-wrapper is inert — not a flex child
description: Component emits anonymous div between .contents and .extra-info-wrapper, making that div the flex item instead. order/flex sizing on .extra-info-wrapper don't apply, causing long titles to push .panel past .wrap instead of ellipsizing.

title: Removing float: right from .panel breaks ERB header layout
description: .row is not a flex container in ERB view, so margin-left: auto and order don't work. Removed float: right was essential for positioning .panel at right edge. Anonymous login button now renders beside logo instead of top-right.

title: .small-action-desc padding change orphans mobile overrides
description: Padding change from 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em to 0 1.5% drops left padding, but mobile override .custom-message { margin-left: -40px } still applies, causing custom messages to hang left and overlap .topic-avatar.

title: .small-action flex container lacks sizing for .small-action-desc
description: .small-action-desc gets no flex value, defaults to flex: 0 1 auto, shrinks to max-content. Delete/edit buttons hug description text instead of right edge. float: left on .topic-avatar is inert in flex context.
